sozlesme.title: GENERAL VEHICLE RENTAL AGREEMENT
sozlesme.lessorNote: These are the companies representing the RENTWİN umbrella brand and group under this agreement, hereinafter referred to as "RENTWİN" or "LESSOR".
sozlesme.a1t: ARTICLE 1: SUBJECT AND SCOPE OF THE AGREEMENT
sozlesme.a1:
This agreement covers the terms on which the motor land vehicles owned, possessed or operated by the LESSOR companies within the RENTWİN umbrella brand are rented to the LESSEE, together with the mutual rights and obligations of the parties.
The vehicle(s) subject to the rental, the rental periods, rental fees, payment plan and special terms are set out in ANNEX-1 (Rental and Financial Detail Form), an integral part of this agreement. ANNEX-2 (Vehicle Handover and Return Report) is drawn up on the physical delivery and return of the vehicles. Upon signing ANNEX-2, legal and physical responsibility for the vehicle passes to the LESSEE.
sozlesme.a2t: ARTICLE 2: CONDITIONS OF USE AND PROHIBITIONS
sozlesme.a2:
2.1. By signing the ANNEX-2 form, the LESSEE accepts that the vehicle was received in compliance with the Highway Traffic Law, complete in mechanical and bodywork condition and with its tool kit.
2.2. Without RENTWİN's written approval, the vehicles may not be used by third parties other than the authorised drivers specified in ANNEX-1 or the agreement (LESSEE personnel holding a valid class B or higher licence).
2.3. Use of the vehicle(s) is strictly prohibited in the following cases:
• Transport of goods contrary to the laws of the Republic of Türkiye, constituting an offence or subject to permit,
• Loading above the carrying capacity (cargo/passenger) or transport that would damage the mechanical integrity of the vehicle,
• Towing or pushing another vehicle, or carrying passengers/cargo for a fee,
• Racing, speed trials, rallies, motor sports, or on terrain closed to or unsuitable for traffic,
• Driving under the influence of alcohol, narcotics or stimulants.
2.4. The LESSEE may not modify the vehicle, its accessories or parts without RENTWİN's written approval. (Livery suitable for the rental purpose and roof-basket fitting are subject to RENTWİN's written permission.)
2.5. The vehicles may not be taken abroad without RENTWİN's written permission.
sozlesme.a3t: ARTICLE 3: MAINTENANCE, REPAIR AND REPLACEMENT VEHICLE PROCEDURE
sozlesme.a3:
3.1. The cost of periodic maintenance and of tyre changes at the end of standard service life (50,000 km) belongs to RENTWİN. The LESSEE is obliged to track maintenance mileage and, by informing RENTWİN in advance, deliver the vehicle to an authorised service. Faults arising from delayed maintenance are invoiced to the LESSEE.
3.2. The LESSEE is directly responsible for careless and poor use, wrong fuel use, running the vehicle without water/oil, continuing to drive despite a warning light, undercarriage impacts and faults falling outside the warranty scope.
3.3. In faults caused by RENTWİN or where maintenance exceeds 48 hours, an equivalent/replacement vehicle is provided to the LESSEE. No replacement vehicle is provided for faults or accidents caused by the LESSEE's fault; if requested, an additional rental fee applies.
sozlesme.a4t: ARTICLE 4: INSURANCE, DAMAGE AND ACCIDENT LIABILITY
sozlesme.a4:
4.1. The vehicles are covered by Compulsory Traffic Insurance and RENT A CAR comprehensive (kasko) insurance. Unless otherwise stated in ANNEX-1, the comprehensive deductible is 15,000 TL per accident.
4.2. In the event of an accident or damage, the LESSEE is obliged to notify RENTWİN immediately and, within 48 hours at the latest, deliver to RENTWİN the accident report, police/gendarmerie report, alcohol test report, a copy of the driving licence and photographs taken from at least 4 angles.
4.3. If the driver is under the influence of alcohol/narcotics, unlicensed, found 100% at fault, if the accident scene is left, or if the official documents cannot be obtained, the comprehensive cover is deemed void and all resulting material/moral damages are borne by the LESSEE.
4.4. Tyre, glass and headlight breakage, loss of the spare key, key theft, upholstery burns/stains and loss of in-car accessories are outside comprehensive cover and are compensated by the LESSEE.
sozlesme.a5t: ARTICLE 5: MILEAGE LIMIT, EXCESS AND FUEL
sozlesme.a5limited: Under this agreement the vehicle's usage limit is set at {{kmLimit}}. For every kilometre exceeding the limit, {{kmOverageFee}} is invoiced to the LESSEE. External tampering with the odometer is just cause for termination.
sozlesme.a5unlimited: Under this agreement the vehicle is rented without a mileage limit (unlimited km); no excess-km fee applies. External tampering with the odometer is just cause for termination.
sozlesme.a5fuel: The vehicle is returned at the fuel level at which it was received. For every missing 1/8 tank, {{fuelFee}} is invoiced to the LESSEE.
sozlesme.a6t: ARTICLE 6: FINES, HGS/OGS AND TOLL ROADS
sozlesme.a6: All traffic fines, unpaid HGS/OGS passages, motorway/bridge tolls and towing/parking fees incurred during the rental belong to the LESSEE. Fines and administrative costs that RENTWİN has had to pay are invoiced to the LESSEE immediately, and the LESSEE agrees to pay on first demand.
sozlesme.a7t: ARTICLE 7: FINANCIAL PROVISIONS, SECURITY AND TERMINATION
sozlesme.a7:
7.1. Rental invoices are issued each month on the day corresponding to the start date in ANNEX-1. The invoice payment period is a maximum of 10 days from the issue date.
7.2. Invoices not paid on the due date bear default interest of 3% per month. For delays exceeding 15 days a maturity-difference invoice may be issued; for non-payment exceeding 60 days RENTWİN has the right to terminate the agreement unilaterally and repossess the vehicle.
7.3. RENTWİN may request a security note, letter of guarantee or credit-card block under the agreement.
7.4. If the LESSEE returns the vehicle before the rental period expires, the LESSEE agrees and undertakes to pay RENTWİN 75% of the total rental fee for the remaining period as early-return compensation.
7.5. RENTWİN may fit vehicle-tracking (GPS) and signalling devices to the vehicles. The LESSEE has consented to this tracking and to the storage of the data.
sozlesme.a8: The Courts and Enforcement Offices of İZMİR (or ALİAĞA) are competent for the resolution of any dispute arising from the application of this agreement. The addresses stated by the parties at the beginning of the agreement are their legal notification addresses.
sozlesme.closing: This agreement has been prepared in 8 articles and 2 copies, and signed mutually on {{date}} after being read.

ek1.title: ANNEX-1: RENTAL AND FINANCIAL DETAIL FORM
ek1.intro1: This ANNEX-1 Form is an integral part of the "GENERAL VEHICLE RENTAL AGREEMENT" signed between {{lessor}} (hereinafter "RENTWİN" or "LESSOR", representing the RENTWİN umbrella brand) and {{lessee}} (hereinafter the "LESSEE").
ek1.intro2: This annex constitutes the parties' acceptance of the rental by RENTWİN to the LESSEE of the vehicle(s) detailed below, under the stated financial and operational terms.
ek1.c1: The LESSEE has agreed and undertaken to rent the vehicle(s) detailed above under the stated terms and the provisions of the General Vehicle Rental Agreement.
ek1.c2: Even if the plate, registration and preparation of the vehicles are completed and they are made ready for use, failure to take delivery of the vehicles for reasons attributable to the LESSEE does not change the rental start date.
ek1.c3: Services included and not included in the rental fee are as expressly stated in the articles of the Main Agreement.
ek1.c4: This ANNEX-1 form is an integral part and complement of the Vehicle Rental Agreement concluded by the parties.
ek1.closing: This ANNEX-1 Form consists of 3 articles and has been drawn up in 2 (two) copies and signed by the parties on {{date}}.
